senses.gloss: (I)--a son of आग्निहोत्र and पूर्वचित्ति, and Lord of हेमकूट. भा. V. 2. १९; Br. II. १४. ४५ and ४८; वा. ३३. ३८, ४१; Vi. II. 1. १६ and १९.
(II)--a son of स्वारोचिष Manu. Br. II. ३६. १९; Vi. III. 1. १२.
(IV)--a kind of elf, an attendant on Kubera. Ila's conversion from womanhood into. M. १२. १०.

(III)--a continent of जम्बूद्वीप and bounded by हेमकूट on one side.
1: भा. V. १६. 9; M. ११३. २९; ११४. ५९, ६३-5; १२१. ४९; वा. ३४. २८; Vi. II. 2. १३.
Here हनुमान् worships राम as a friend of all including wild creatures, and as one who led all कोशल people to Heaven.
2: भा. V. १९. 1-8.
Its king Dumna was an ally of जरासन्ध and placed on the west of the Gomanta hill during its siege;
3: Ib. X. ५२. ११ [११].
conquered by परीक्षित्.
4: Ib. I. १६. १३.
There is प्लक्ष- खण्ड like Nandana: People drink of प्लक्ष and live for १०,000 years and are of golden colour; note for मधुवह trees.
5: Br. II. १७. 1-5; १८. ७४; वा. ४६. 2-6; ४७. ७१.

--a class of divinities, born out of Brahma's shadow just like Kinnaras.
1: भा. III. २०. ४५.
Frequent कैलास hill.
2: Ib. IV. 6. ३१.
Joined gods in singing नृसिम्ह's praise.
3: Ib. VII. 8. ३८.
Learnt dharma from the seven sages.
4: Ib. XI. १४. 6.
Belong to the line of क्रोधवशा.
5: Br. III. 7. १७६; 8. ७१; ४१. ३०; IV. ३०. 9; ३३. २७.
[page१-379+ ३२]
--between hills वसुधार and Ratna- धार; here is the temple of the sun god where every month the sun descends. वा. ३८. २७-32.
